university.name: Emilio Aguinaldo College
university.location: Paco, Manila (main campus; secondary campus in Dasmariñas, Cavite)
university.description: Private non-sectarian university founded in 1957, with its main campus on San Marcelino Street in Manila. Known for allied health sciences, nursing, medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, and therapy programs, with hospital-affiliated clinical training.
university.tuition: Approximately P40,000–P90,000 per semester (health sciences and lab-heavy programs higher; estimate — EAC does not publish official fee tables online; verify with finance/registrar)

courses_research_notes: Manila campus schools/colleges (official admissions): School of Arts and Sciences (BA Communication, BS Psychology, BS Biology); School of Business Education (BS Business Administration — Financial/Marketing/Operations Management); School of Criminology (BS Criminology, BS Real Estate Management); School of Dentistry (Doctor of Dental Medicine); School of Engineering and Technology (BS Computer Engineering, BS Information Technology); School of Hospitality & Tourism Management (BS Hospitality Management); School of Medical Technology; Marian School of Nursing (BS Nursing); School of Nutrition and Dietetics (BS Nutrition and Dietetics); School of Pharmacy; School of Physical, Occupational, & Respiratory Therapy; School of Radiologic Technology; School of Midwifery & Caregiving (BS Midwifery); School of Teacher Education (BSEd English, BSEd Social Studies); School of Medicine (Doctor of Medicine); Graduate School (PhD Educational Management, MA Education, MA Nursing, ETEEAP). Cavite campus offers additional programs (e.g. JD) not listed on Manila admissions page.
